data.name: Karyl
data.gender_notes: Karyl is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'katharos', meaning 'pure', 'clear', or 'clean'. In the New Testament, the name Karyl is used for a man who brought a jar of perfume worth three hundred denarii to anoint Jesus' feet with it. This act of devotion and purity is a fitting reminder of the spiritual significance of the name. The name Karyl carries the meaning “Pure, clear” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Karyl usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, clear and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing purity and devotion.
data.etymology: Karyl belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pure, clear.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Karyl total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_hebrew.name: קריל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: שם ילד שמקורו במילה 'קרא' (לקרות, לקראת) ו'ילד', ומשמעותו 'ילד הנפש הקדושה' - השם 'קריל' הוא שם אשכנזי לא נפוץ, ומקורו בראשי תיבות של כינוי ישראל (קראת את-לוה-ימין). בדראסי (דף 10) 'קריל' מוזכר כשם לא נפוץ, וקובע שמקורו ב'קרא' ו'ילד'. בעבר, השם 'קריל' היה שם יהודי נפוץ בחבל הארץ, והוא מוזכר גם בספר 'הספר הגדול' (דף 22) בקשר לר' קריל, רבה של ירושלים.

in_greek.name: Καρύλ
in_greek.long_meaning: Όνομα που προέρχεται από τις ελληνικές ρίζες 'καρυς' (θείο, θείο) και 'λαος' (λαός, παιδί) και σημαίνει 'παιδί του θεού'. Ο όρος 'Καρύλ' δεν είναι πολύ κοινός στις αρχαίες ελληνικές πηγές, αλλά μπορεί να σχετιστεί με την αρχαία ελληνική λέξη 'καρυς', που σημαίνει 'θείο' ή 'θεία'.

in_latin.name: Karyl
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen quod ex radicibus Graecis 'karus' (divinus, divinus) et 'laos' (laos, puer) provenit et significationem habet 'puer divini'. Nomen 'Karyl' non est commune in fontibus antiquis Graecis, sed potest esse coniunctum cum vocabulo antiquo Graeco 'karus', quod significat 'divinus' aut 'divina'.

in_english.name: Karyl
in_english.meaning: Child of the divine or heavenly name
in_english.long_meaning: The name Karyl originates from the Hebrew root 'qara' (to call) and 'yelad' (child), meaning 'child of the divine name'. Although Karyl is not a common name in Jewish tradition, it has its roots in the biblical concept of calling God's name. In Christian tradition, the name Karyl represents a child who is called by God's name, symbolizing their spiritual significance and relationship with the divine.

The name Karyl also recalls the story in the New Testament of the man who brought a costly perfume to anoint Jesus' feet. This act of devotion and selflessness serves as an inspiring example of the importance of purity of heart and intent in our relationship with God and with others.
